_fixture_envelope.description: Time punch spanning the 2026-03-08 US/Canada DST spring-forward (02:00 local jumps to 03:00). The location's IANA timezone is America/Toronto. Punch `clocked_in` is 06:30 UTC (= 01:30 local before DST) and `clocked_out` is 11:00 UTC (= 07:00 local after DST). Wall-clock between 02:00 and 03:00 EST does not exist on 2026-03-08; UTC instants are unambiguous.
_fixture_envelope.expected_behavior: Adapter persists the UTC instants directly; the iana_timezone_converter computes business_date in America/Toronto and the wage hours derive from the UTC delta (4h 30m), NOT from a naive local-clock subtraction (which would mis-count the missing hour).
